title: Wick Liquor Contra 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Contra by Wick Liquor is a striking contrast of flavours, combining the zesty brightness of Citrus Fruit with the rich sweetness of a mixed Fruit Compote. The tangy top notes are balanced by a smooth, syrupy undertone, creating a vape that’s both lively and indulgent. This Shortfill provides 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml bottle, leaving space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg shots makes 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. With its 70VG/30PG ratio, Contra is designed for sub-ohm tanks and high-powered kits, producing thick vapour and bold flavour expression. Produced in the UK, Wick Liquor’s reputation for distinctive flavour combinations is perfectly captured in Contra, offering a mix of sharp citrus zest and mellow fruit depth.
